clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside south Texas in the United States

source.quote: Falfurrias ( fal-FURE-ee-əss) is a city in and the county seat of Brooks County, Texas, United States.

clues.text: This town is in south Texas, in the United States. It is the main town of its county, Brooks County.

clues.narrowing: rules out wet places; points to dry land harsh enough to kill people on foot

source.quote: many migrants seeking to bypass the checkpoint by setting off across the arid land die of exposure and dehydration

clues.text: This town stands in dry, arid land. People who try to cross that land on foot can die from exposure and from lack of water.

clues.narrowing: narrows to towns named for a founder's ranch that was among the largest in Texas in 1893

source.quote: The town is named for founder Edward Cunningham Lasater's ranch, La Mota de Falfurrias. In 1893, the Falfurrias ranch was one of the largest in Texas at some 350,000 acres (140,000 ha).

clues.text: This town was named for the ranch of its founder, Edward Cunningham Lasater. In 1893 that ranch was one of the largest in all of Texas.

clues.narrowing: near-decisive: the south Texas town tied to the Missing in Brooks County film

source.quote: Falfurrias and Brooks County were featured in a 2014 Latino USA radio story on illegal immigration in South Texas. The 2021 movie Missing in Brooks County deals with the same topic.

clues.text: A 2021 film, Missing in Brooks County, told of migrants in this part of Texas. A radio show had shared the same theme back in 2014.

clues.narrowing: confirms the town whose Border Patrol checkpoint on Route 281 is its biggest industry

source.quote: The biggest industry in Falfurrias is the United States Border Patrol interior checkpoint south of the city on U.S. Route 281.

clues.text: South of this town, on Route 281, stands a Border Patrol checkpoint. It is the biggest source of work in the whole town.
